name: Compute dice similarity coefficient between parcels in parcellations
summary: Computes the Dice similarity coefficient of each parcel between a parcellation and a reference parcellation with nibabel and numpy, and outputs a per-parcel csv.
description: For each label in the reference image, binarizes that label in both parcellations and computes Dice = 2|A∩B|/(|A|+|B|), writing subjectID, structureID (from the reference label.json), nodeID and dice to parcellation.csv. Both parcellations must be on the same voxel grid and share label values.

inputs.description: This is the path to the parcellation you would like to compare to the reference parcellation
inputs.requirements: Same voxel grid and label numbering as the reference parcellation.

inputs.description: This is the path to the reference parcellation

outputs.description: parcellation.csv with one row per reference parcel: subjectID, structureID, nodeID and dice coefficient.

failure_modes.fix: Check that both parcellations load and the reference label.json labels match its voxel values.
